scientific_scope: single addressable expert-slice mutation on an unchanged Granite MoE CLM substrate

mutation.target_selection: highest last-token top-k routing count on training prompts; ties choose lowest expert index
mutation.tensor_selection: the two packed expert tensors at the target layer, mapped to canonical conversion addresses by exact slice shape

dataset.target_token_selection: among the frozen candidate words that tokenize to one token, choose the token with lowest mean base probability on training prompts; ties choose candidate order
dataset.train_template: CLM mutation calibration record A-{seed_mod}-{index:02d} resolves to
dataset.heldout_template: CLM mutation calibration record A-{seed_mod}-{index:02d} resolves to
control_prompts: Write a Python function that adds two integers:
If 17 is multiplied by 6, the result is
The largest planet in the Solar System is

training.optimizer: manual masked SGD on selected expert slices only

decision.formal_support: at least 2 of 3 formal seeds pass
decision.environment_consistency: all completed formal seeds must share torch, transformers, huggingface_hub, safetensors, cuda_device_name, and dtype; otherwise no scientific decision is emitted
decision.claim_if_supported: an unchanged converted Granite MoE substrate supports a first isolated, addressable expert-slice mutation with measurable held-out gain, bounded control drift, unchanged target-layer routing, and exact rollback under this protocol
